glosses: Enregistrer un contenu dans un fichier ou document en supprimant le contenu antérieur.

examples.text: L’erreur est survenue lorsque vous avez essayé de surécrire ou d’ajouter des données à un fichier existant créé par un tiers.

Du côté de Willy, elle nous irrite au contraire parce qu’elle en fait trop, qu’elle surjoue, elle qui se produisit dans sa jeunesse, au music-hall, dans le plus simple appareil, parce qu’elle surécrit, qu’elle se pare de fanfreluches parfaitement inutiles.
Der Journalist überschreibt seine Artikel meist mit einer sensationsheischenden Schlagzeile.
Sie überschrieb ihrem Bruder Haus und Hof und zog nach Uruguay.
„Die Aufsicht über den Religionsunterricht wurde den staatlichen Behörden überschrieben.“

glosses: in einem Speicher vorhandene Daten ersetzen

examples.text: Eine Datei mit diesem Namen existiert bereits. Soll sie überschrieben werden?

glosses: To destroy (older) data by recording new data over it.

examples.text: I accidentally saved my unwanted changes and overwrote the version of the document I wanted to keep.

glosses: To cover in writing; to write over the top of.

examples.text: Many trainees consider that by increasing the length of the piece they will construct a good feature. This is often not the case and overwriting can lead to vague and muddled features that confuse the reader and ultimately lose their interest.

glosses: To write in an unnecessarily complicated or florid way; to produce purple prose.

examples.text: The Times of course has to pay the price of encyclopaedism by being often dreadfully overwritten, with long paragraphs connected by motley conjunctions.
He overwrites constantly, but his detailed and understated one-paragraph description of Monroe's apartment in New York (pp. 216-18) injects high voltage into the de casibus tradition.

That said, the passage just looked at anticipates rather than participates in greatness. It is too adjectival, a stylistic flaw which suggests an insistence more apparent in the ensuing lines (182-91), where one is torn between thinking that Shelley is overwriting and that he is staying close to a feverish intensity.
